SECTION B: (2 Marks Each)

Q21(A). Evaluate:
(5cos^2 60° + 4sec^2 30° - tan^2 45°) / (sin^2 30° + cos^2 30°)
OR
Q21(B). If sin(A − B) = 1/2 and cos(A + B) = 1/2, where 0° < A + B ≤ 90° and A > B, find A and B.

Answer / Solution (A):
Denominator: sin^2θ + cos^2θ = 1, so denominator = 1.
cos60° = 1/2 => cos^2 60° = 1/4
sec30° = 2/√3 => sec^2 30° = 4/3
tan45° = 1 => tan^2 45° = 1
Value = 5(1/4) + 4(4/3) - 1 = 5/4 + 16/3 - 1
LCM 12 => (15 + 64 - 12)/12 = 67/12
Answer: 67/12

Answer / Solution (B):
A - B = 30° (since sin30°=1/2)
A + B = 60° (since cos60°=1/2)
Add: 2A = 90° => A = 45°
Then B = 60° - 45° = 15°
Answer: A = 45°, B = 15°
